config.neo4j.cypher.topic.delivery_orders_strea: WITH coalesce(__value.payload, __value) AS row WHERE row.user_id IS NOT NULL AND row.order_id IS NOT NULL MERGE (c:Customer {id: 'CUST_' + row.user_id}) MERGE (o:Order {id: row.order_id}) ON CREATE SET o.amount = toFloat(coalesce(row.amount, 0.0)), o.status = row.status ON MATCH SET o.status = row.status MERGE (c)-[r:PLACED_ORDER]->(o) ON CREATE SET r.created_at = timestamp() ON MATCH SET r.updated_at = timestamp()
config.neo4j.cypher.topic.order_items_stream: WITH coalesce(__value.payload, __value) AS row WHERE row.order_id IS NOT NULL AND row.package_id IS NOT NULL MERGE (o:Order {id: row.order_id}) MERGE (pkg:SKU_Package {id: row.package_id}) ON CREATE SET pkg.type = row.package_type, pkg.weight = toFloat(coalesce(row.weight, 0.0)) MERGE (o)-[r:CONTAINS_PACKAGE]->(pkg) ON MATCH SET r.last_verified_at = timestamp()
